term: Describe the objective, procedure, observation, and principle for Activity 2.9 (To observe the role of Lactobacillus bacteria in milk curdling at different temperatures.).
phonetic_guide: [Phonetic Guide: describe the objective, procedure, observation, and principle for activity 2.9 (to observe the role of lactobacillus bacteria in milk curdling at different temperatures.).]
definition:
Aim: To observe the role of Lactobacillus bacteria in milk curdling at different temperatures.
Materials: Two bowls of milk (lukewarm and cold), Starter curd containing Lactobacillus
Steps: Add a spoonful of starter curd to lukewarm milk (Bowl A) and cold milk (Bowl B). Keep Bowl A in a warm location and Bowl B in a refrigerator for 6-8 hours. Examine coagulation, texture, and acidity.
Observation: Bowl A coagulates into firm curd; Bowl B remains liquid milk.
Principle: Lactobacillus bacteria require warm optimal temperatures to multiply and ferment lactose into lactic acid.

term: Explain why adding starter curd to extremely hot boiling milk fails to produce curd.
phonetic_guide: [Phonetic Guide: explain why adding starter curd to extremely hot boiling milk fails to produce curd.]

term: Discuss the major economic and industrial applications of microorganisms across agriculture, medicine, and food production.
phonetic_guide: [Phonetic Guide: discuss the major economic and industrial applications of microorganisms across agriculture, medicine, and food production.]
definition: 1. Agriculture: Rhizobium bacteria fix atmospheric nitrogen in legume root nodules to enrich soil fertility. 2. Medicine: Fungi like Penicillium produce life-saving antibiotics; weakened pathogens are used to prepare vaccines. 3. Food Industry: Lactobacillus ferments milk into curd/cheese; yeast produces CO2 to make bread soft and fluffy. 4. Waste & Energy: Methanogenic bacteria break down organic waste to produce biogas fuel and rich manure.
